name: Zenkaikon
blurb: A volunteer-run, nonprofit anime and sci-fi convention at the Lancaster County Convention Center, with cosplay contests, an artist alley and late-night dances.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'March 18-21, 2027 Lancaster County Convention Center, Lancaster, PA ... Zenkaikon 2027 March 18 - 21, 2027 - Lancaster, PA'; location address confirmed: '25 South Queen Street Lancaster, PA 17603'.

notes: The /guests/ page's own section heading reads '2026 Guests' (18 names: Caitlin Glass, Dana Terrace, Dante Basco, Phil LaMarr, Khary Payton, Jeremy Shada, etc.) -- that is last year's roster, not yet replaced for the March 2027 edition, so guests is 'none-yet' per the rules rather than picking a stale lineup. The homepage's own 'Hours of Programming / Program Items / Exhibitors / Event Participants' stat block is also explicitly labeled '2026' for the same reason. 2026-10-08: the /guests/ page now has a separate '2027 Guests' section with Olivia Olson (card art reads 'Zenkaikon 2027', Voice Actor), so guests is announced with 1 guest; the '2026 Guests' section below it is last year's roster and was not picked.
